speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether there are further measures to encourage higher labour force participation to address the labour crunch and reduce dependence on foreign labour.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This is comparable to the top five OECD countries.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: In particular, more women and seniors have joined the workforce, even during the pandemic.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: While the LFPR in Singapore is already relatively high, we can, potentially, increase it further.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: One key strategy is to make work more flexible, so that more can participate.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This will allow more workers to remain in the workforce or return to the workforce while meeting other needs, such as caregiving.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Government is also committed to improving access to affordable and quality preschool services, which enables parents with young children to go to work with peace of mind.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This will support more senior workers who wish to continue to work to do so.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Employers can also tap on career conversion programmes which provide higher support levels for mature hires.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Fundamentally, to cope with the manpower crunch, our businesses need to continue to transform, increase their productivity and improve manpower efficiency.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Government remains committed to supporting businesses and workers to achieve this.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Sector agencies are working closely with industries across the 23 Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs).

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Workforce Singapore has rolled out Job Redesign and Reskilling Programmes to support employers to upskill their employees to take on enhanced job roles.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Other schemes, such as the Enterprise Development Grant and the Productivity Solutions Grant, are also available to help our businesses strengthen their capabilities.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.
